.classification-note{margin-top:32px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid #e2e4e8}.classification-note h3{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 18px}.classification-note dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}.classification-note dt{font-size:12px;color:#5d6471}.classification-note dd{margin:6px 0;font-size:15px}.classification-note details{margin-top:18px}.classification-note details small{display:block;color:#586070;font-size:12px}.classification-note .classification-review{padding:14px 16px;background:#f2eff8;border-radius:9px;color:#574872}.topic-filters{scrollbar-width:thin}.drawer-taxonomy{color:#514071;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;margin:16px 0}.filter-panel{max-height:min(75vh,660px);overflow-y:auto}@media(max-width:767px){.classification-note dl{grid-template-columns:1fr}.filter-panel{max-height:65vh}}

.stage-version-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px}.stage-version-links>a:not(.stage-report-link){font-size:11px;color:#586478}
</style></head>
